variants.name: tablet
variants.prompt: Create a responsive alternative composition of the provided Villow website landscape. This is an image edit, preserve its exact visual language: soft sage green layered rolling hills, subtle painted gradients with restrained texture, creamy nearly white sky, pale warm yellow sunrise glow, simple dark green tree silhouettes, cream cloud shapes and tiny green birds. No hard black outlines, no extra visual complexity, no characters, buildings, text, UI, border or watermark. Keep the horizon gently rolling and broad; not steep mountains or a repetitive sine wave. Render one finished seamless full-bleed landscape, opaque background. The purpose is a website decorative horizon below headline and illustration, not a whole website mockup. Preserve calm and huge open sky in the upper 45 percent, a large continuous middle band of open sky; put all hills and trees in the lower third, softly glowing sun just above and partially behind hills. Match original colors very closely. TABLET composition: horizontal 2:1 canvas, about 1536 by 768. Recompose rather than squeezing the wide original. Sun at about 73% horizontal position, center at 75% image height, modest size about 11% of width. A compact tree cluster touches left edge, two tiny trees touch right edge. One subtle cloud near 15% width and another near 85%, both at about 53% image height. Three tiny birds near 69% width at about 56% height. Broad diagonal layers of hills and a darker foreground at bottom. Leave quiet negative space upper and middle center.
